title: Fontshow Inventory Schema v1.5
description: Canonical Fontshow inventory schema for normalized font discovery, enrichment, and LaTeX-oriented validation metadata.

metadata.description: Inventory-wide metadata describing the producer, runtime environment, and validation context associated with the inventory file.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for this inventory document.

input_inventory_tool.description: Command or component that produced the current inventory payload.

input_inventory_tool_version.description: Version string of the tool that produced the current inventory payload.

inference_level.description: Inference strictness or enrichment level applied to the inventory.

fonttools.description: Versioned metadata about the fontTools extraction surface available when the inventory was produced.

available.description: Whether fontTools was available to the producing command.

fontconfig_charset_included.description: Whether Fontconfig charset-derived information was included in the inventory.

version.description: fontTools version reported during inventory generation.

run_environment.description: Minimal system identification for reproducibility and diagnostics.

os.description: Operating-system name reported by the producing environment.

os_release.description: Operating-system release identifier of the producing environment.

kernel.description: Kernel identifier of the producing environment.

machine.description: Machine architecture reported by the producing environment.

python_version.description: Python runtime version used by the producing command.

hostname.description: Hostname reported by the producing environment.

execution_context.description: Normalized execution context classification for the producing environment.

validation.description: Inventory-wide validation metadata for external runtime surfaces relevant to downstream processing.

lualatex.description: Inventory-level LaTeX runtime metadata describing the LuaLaTeX environment associated with validation and loadability decisions.

fonts.description: List of normalized per-face font entries contained in the inventory.

font_entry.description: Canonical per-face inventory entry containing identity, metrics, enrichment, typography, and validation state.

path.description: Canonical font file path. Multiple faces in the same file share this path.

family.description: Canonical family name associated with the font face.

subfamily.description: Style or face name reported for the font entry.

typographic_subfamily.description: Typographic subfamily name when available, otherwise null.

postscript_name.description: PostScript face name used for stable font identification.

version_string.description: Version string extracted from the font metadata.

unique_font_id.description: Deterministic Fontshow identifier for the font face.

metrics.description: Normalized technical metrics and numeric font properties.

coverage.description: Coverage and Unicode-derived enrichment data associated with the font.

inference.description: Inference outputs derived from coverage, charset, and language processing.

charset.description: Charset-oriented raw or normalized data retained for downstream analysis.

typography.description: Typography-oriented rendering metadata, specimens, and render-policy fields.

loadability.description: Per-font persisted loadability state for external rendering engines.

warnings.description: Structured warnings attached to the font entry during inventory generation or enrichment.

metrics.description: Normalized numeric metrics and technical font properties used for diagnostics and downstream policy decisions.

units_per_em.description: Units-per-em value reported by the font.

ascent.description: Ascent metric reported by the font.

descent.description: Descent metric reported by the font.

italic_angle.description: Italic angle reported by the font.

is_fixed_pitch.description: Whether the font is reported as fixed-pitch or monospaced.

glyph_count.description: Number of glyphs reported by the font.

typography.description: Typography-oriented fields used for specimen generation, script labeling, and render-policy selection.

sample_text.description: Embedded sample text extracted from the font itself.

source.description: Provenance label for the embedded sample text.

text.description: Sample text extracted from the font, which may be empty when no embedded sample is available.

specimen_text.description: Final deterministic specimen text chosen for rendering and validation.

specimen_strategy.description: Strategy that produced the final specimen text.

specimen_glyph_count.description: Count of accepted base glyphs in the final specimen text.

specimen_rejection_reason.description: Structured rejection or fallback reason recorded during specimen generation.

primary_script.description: Primary script code selected for the font, when one is available.

script_display_name.description: Human-readable display label associated with the primary script.

render_policy.description: LaTeX-oriented render-policy values derived from the selected script.

polyglossia_language.description: Polyglossia language identifier associated with the selected script, when applicable.

fontspec_opts.description: fontspec option fragment associated with the selected script, when applicable.

script_source.description: Source from which the primary script decision was derived.

opentype_features.description: Reported OpenType feature tags preserved for typography-oriented inspection.

loadability.description: Per-font persisted loadability state for external engines that may reject or constrain rendering.

lualatex.description: Persisted LuaLaTeX loadability result for the current font entry.

attempted.description: Whether LuaLaTeX loadability probing has been attempted for this font.

loadable.description: Persisted LuaLaTeX loadability result when probing has produced a definitive outcome.

reason.description: Deterministic short reason or failure summary associated with the persisted loadability state.

runtime_fingerprint.description: Runtime fingerprint under which the per-font loadability result was computed.

probe_input.description: Serialized probe input or probe-selection hint associated with the persisted validation attempt.

render_variants.description: Per-render-path LuaLaTeX validation results derived after parse-time script and render-policy enrichment.

script.description: ISO-15924 script code for the validated render path.

fontspec_opts.description: Resolved fontspec option string used for the validated render path.

attempted.description: Whether LuaLaTeX validation was attempted for this render path.

loadable.description: Persisted LuaLaTeX result for this render path.

reason.description: Deterministic short reason or failure summary for this render path.

runtime_fingerprint.description: Runtime fingerprint under which this render-path result was computed.

probe_input.description: Serialized probe input or probe-selection hint associated with this render-path validation attempt.

specimen_text.description: Validated specimen text that succeeded or was attempted for this render path.

specimen_glyph_count.description: Accepted base-glyph count for the persisted render-variant specimen.

specimen_strategy.description: Deterministic strategy label describing how the persisted render-variant specimen was produced.

lualatex_validation_metadata.description: Inventory-level metadata describing the LuaLaTeX-related program surface used for validation and loadability decisions.

attempted.description: Whether inventory-wide LuaLaTeX validation or probing has been attempted.

engine.description: Name of the LaTeX engine associated with the validation metadata.

engine_version.description: Version string reported by the LaTeX engine.

texlive_version.description: TeX Live release identifier reported by the associated LaTeX runtime, when available.

luaotfload_version.description: Version of the luaotfload package available in the associated LaTeX runtime.

fontspec_version.description: Version of the fontspec package available in the associated LaTeX runtime.

polyglossia_version.description: Version of the Polyglossia package available in the associated LaTeX runtime.

runtime_fingerprint.description: Stable fingerprint of the relevant LaTeX runtime surface.

render_policy_version.description: Version or fingerprint of the render-policy inputs associated with validation.

warning.description: Structured warning record attached to an inventory font entry.
